scientific_integrity: Proof is symbolic for all permitted numbers of parts and all part-preserving subgroups; 233 finite checks are independent corroboration of the orbit-complex face identification and mod-two Betti predictions. Literature overlap with ambient invariants is explicitly excluded; possible unindexed or unavailable fixed-point statements remain a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Classification covers geometric fixed spaces for part-preserving subgroups only, for at least two nonempty parts, each with at least two vertices. It does not cover permutations of parts or residual normalizer-equivariant homotopy. Finite mod-two checks support but do not prove the theorem; general conclusion follows from cofibration and cover arguments. Related ambient homotopy and integral homology symmetry module were previously known.
title: Geometric fixed-point types of complete multipartite closed-neighborhood complexes
